text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PDR-84217 fired for service=inference-gateway-prod — error_rate(5xx) spiking > 12% over 5m (threshold 5%). Auto-page to #incidents.
pagerduty-bot: PDR-84217 assigned to Alex Rivera (on-call primary). Please acknowledge.
Alex Rivera: ACK. seeing the spike in grafana, digging in. anyone seeing deploys?
Maria Chen: not from product side, no deploys reported in the last hour. checking LB metrics.
Priya Kaur: I see high connection resets on edge-proxy in logs right now, lots of 502/504s. sending tail.
Priya Kaur: ```
2026-03-15T03:22:11Z edge-proxy-12 conn reset by peer upstream_id=up-34 status=502 path=/v1/generate
2026-03-15T03:22:12Z edge-proxy-13 upstream timeout id=up-34 status=504
```
Dan Lopez: Confirmed — kvcache eviction rate jumped at 03:20, followed by backend overload on k8s node pool gwe-evict-*.
Alex Rivera: Oncall checklist: 1) confirm customer impact 2) attempt graceful fallback 3) scale or drain bad nodes 4) canary rollback if rollout.
Maria Chen: Customer impact — looks like 8% of requests get 5xx, mostly long-tail seq > 1024. Some paid users seeing errors. alerting support for customer check-in.
Priya Kaur: Running quick query to find correlated traces: `sum by(code) (rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",code=~"5.."}[5m]))` -> spike mainly 502/504.
Alex Rivera: Good. Can we route traffic to backup model-variant for heavy sequences? Routing policy v2 supports fallback to small-kv model.
Dan Lopez: Doing temporary route weight shift now: will move 30% traffic off inference-gateway-prod to inference-gateway-fallback.
deploy-bot: Traffic routing change applied: inference-gateway-prod weight -> 70%, inference-gateway-fallback -> 30%.
Alex Rivera: Monitoring error rate after shift...
Maria Chen: Error % dropped to ~7% after reroute. still above baseline but improving.
Priya Kaur: kvcache eviction traces show memory pressure on hosts gwe-7 and gwe-9. reprovisioning more cache capacity recommended.
Dan Lopez: Spinning up 2 more cache nodes in the pool (nodescaling request started). ETA ~3m.
Alex Rivera: If nodes come up, we should see cache miss rate drop and fewer backend timeouts. keep PD open until stable.
Priya Kaur: Also seeing a surge of longer contexts — batching config might be combining long sequences causing KV blowup. Suggest limiting max_batch_tokens temporarily.
Maria Chen: I can patch routing policy to reject requests > 2048 tokens with 429 for now (quick protective measure) — will that cause more customer noise?
Alex Rivera: Prefer 503 fallback rather than 429 for those heavy requests so clients retry against fallback path. Maria, apply guardrail to mark heavy requests for fallback.
Maria Chen: Will do. Pushing small config change to edge filter.```
Maria Chen: Config change pushed: edge-filter now tags requests with tokens>2048 -> route=fallback.
pagerduty-bot: PDR-84217 acknowledged by Alex Rivera at 2026-03-15T03:24:10Z.
Alex Rivera: Cache nodes are green, cache miss rate dropping. error rate down to 3.2% overall.
Priya Kaur: Traces show most residual errors are retries from older clients not honoring new routing header. support team notified to reach out to top affected customers.
Dan Lopez: Can we enable a short-term autoscale policy for the inference workers to add 20% headroom?
Alex Rivera: Approved. Dan, go for it.
Dan Lopez: Autoscale change applied. New pods create successfully.
Maria Chen: I'll leave the routing fallback active for 1 hour then reassess.
Alex Rivera: Great. Starting a 30-min observation window. If stable, we'll close incident and file a postmortem. Please add any customer impact notes.
Priya Kaur: Affected customers: list pulled — 4 orgs saw >10% error rate. Support outreach started.
Maria Chen: Quick mitigation summary: 1) routed heavy requests to fallback 2) limit token-based direct routes 3) added cache nodes 4) enabled autoscale 5) support notified.
Alex Rivera: Thanks team. Leaving incident open for observation. If anything regresses, ping PD to wake oncall.
Dan Lopez: Noting action items for postmortem: kvcache sizing, batching guardrails, routing header rollout verification.
Alex Rivera: solid. closing handoff to Maria at 03:41 for watch. Maria, take over as incident lead.
Maria Chen: Taking lead. I'll post a short incident summary in 15m and coordinate with eng-sre for PM. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty-bot: PDR-84217 status changed to monitoring at 2026-03-15T03:41:50Z.
incident-bot: Incident thread pinned in #incidents for follow-up and postmortem action items.
Alex Rivera: ack handoff. thanks everyone.
Maria Chen: will file follow-up ticket and link to runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/inference/kvcache-502-spike
Priya Kaur: adding trace IDs and representative logs to the ticket.
Dan Lopez: final check — error rate stable at 2.8% for last 10m, latency p95 within SLOs. I'll mark scaling rollback plan in case of normal traffic.
Maria Chen: closing observation window in 10m unless we see a bump. Good job team. :clap:
